class.name: BehaviorTreeDecorator
class.brief_description: Resource-backed single-child behavior tree decorator with cycle checks.
class.description: Foundation for behavior tree tasks that alter the outcome or timing of exactly one child. The child task Resource can be shared across multiple runners: runtime progress is stored in each runner's execution memory using a separate path per occurrence. Circular child references are rejected. [BehaviorTreeTimeout] and [BehaviorTreeCooldown] implement specific policies.

method.name: set_task
method.description: Sets the wrapped child task after validating that it does not introduce a cycle. Passing null clears the child.

method.name: get_task
method.description: Returns the wrapped child task, or null.
